solution:
SELECT s.id, s.name FROM Student s
LEFT JOIN Result r ON s.id = r.student_id AND r.subject = 'Computing'
WHERE r.student_id IS NULL
ORDER BY s.id;

steps.text: Select each student ID and name.
Keep every student, attaching only their Computing result if present.
Keep unmatched students, whose result-side ID is NULL.
Order the remaining students by ID.
